_help: Copy this to config.json and edit the paths for this machine. config.json is gitignored, since these paths are machine-specific. Relative paths are relative to this folder.
_session_roots_help: Folders that CONTAIN day-stamped folders (30062026, 02062026, ...). Point at the parent, not at a day folder itself, or the scan finds nothing.
_pipeline_help: Folder holding extract_session_clip.py. Only needed for export; everything else works without it.
_ffmpeg_help: Full path to ffmpeg. On Windows a winget install lands somewhere like the path below - check yours rather than copying this one.
_cache_help: Scratch space for prepared windows. Omit to use the system temp dir; set it to a bigger disk if temp is tight.
_prepare_help: A prepared window transcodes small upright lens videos and pre-renders LiDAR frames either side of it, so the lag slider costs nothing to move. lag_pad_s is how far beyond the window LiDAR is rendered - it caps how far the slider can travel.
